title: Knowledge bank composite integration readiness
objective: Integrate the strongest durable ideas from the read-only feature/evals family into the canonical N knowledge lifecycle without duplicating the bank, weakening evidence boundaries, or claiming human approval.

donors_inspected.accepted: separate evaluation layers and non-averageable hard gates
donors_inspected.rejected: parallel evaluator trees and wholesale branch integration

donors_inspected.accepted: composition, role evidence, mosaic privacy, and receipt controls
donors_inspected.rejected: a second proof bank or publication registry

donors_inspected.accepted: separate share and launch profiles bound to fingerprints
donors_inspected.rejected: treating code-review readiness as launch approval

donors_inspected.accepted: source, browser, runtime, semantic, and human evidence layers
donors_inspected.rejected: averaging a failed evidence layer into a passing score

donors_inspected.accepted: hiring legibility, proof debt, responsive repair, cutover and rollback
donors_inspected.rejected: duplicated deployment machinery and donor-specific page forks
optimizer-authored grades and incomparable score scales
solo-causality, title inflation, and collaborator erasure

donors_inspected.accepted: graph integrity, mutation sensitivity, frozen inputs, and no self-grading
separate claim maturity from projection candidacy
donors_inspected.rejected: automatic publication when a claim gains support

donors_inspected.accepted: append-safe intake, bounded query, report, and leak checks
donors_inspected.rejected: an alternate datastore, CMS, or public search surface
equating non-recovery with nonexistence or capture with publication rights

donors_inspected.accepted: approachable recursive protocol and honest human stops
donors_inspected.rejected: ceremonial process that obscures unresolved human decisions

donors_inspected.accepted: canonical schema, records, citations, corpora, and frozen 27-eval suite
donors_inspected.rejected: replacement of the canonical N lifecycle or modification of its frozen suite

labels.4: complete, exact-set, mutation-sensitive, and independently checked

hard_constraints: Keep the existing 27-eval portfolio suite frozen.
Do not merge or cherry-pick donor branches wholesale.
Do not create a second knowledge bank, publication registry, database, CMS, or public search surface.
Do not publish private locators, raw archives, credentials, protected correspondence, unapproved photos, or participant data.
Do not convert not-recovered into did-not-exist.
Do not strengthen individual ownership, title, causality, endorsement, or institutional authority beyond the evidence.
Do not count a protocol, automated score, or AI judgment as human approval.
Do not enable production indexing without Jamie's approval of the exact candidate.

evals.title: Pinned provenance and minimal integration
procedure: Verify the baseline branch and commit.
Verify donor A-N references and selective-integration notes.
Reject wholesale donor merges, copied historical suite trees, and unexplained duplicate systems.
pass_criteria: Baseline and contract version are pinned.
All donors are accounted for.
Canonical N surfaces remain authoritative.
The candidate fingerprint is reproducible.
evals.remediation_hint: Remove duplicate machinery and document the smallest canonical integration.

evals.title: Exact knowledge graph and no-loss controls
procedure: Run all existing lifecycle, citation, corpus, and route checks.
Validate stable IDs and every graph reference.
Mutation-test orphan, duplicate, unsupported, and retired-public-wording failures.
pass_criteria: All exact-set graph checks pass.
Every canonical record retains intake disposition.
Every public proof has canonical coverage or explicit proof debt.
Existing corpora and citations do not regress.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the canonical record or explicit debt state; never hide an orphan by deleting evidence.

evals.title: Agency and collective-credit integrity
procedure: Classify every public proof that assigns Jamie a role.
Verify actor, bounded action, object, purpose, usable result, credit scope, support, confidence, and anti-claim.
Mutation-test solo causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, and endorsement drift.
pass_criteria: The role-evidence classification is an exact set.
Every careful or collective proof has an agency relation.
Jamie remains visible without taking collective or institutional credit.
Known causal inferences remain labeled or held.
evals.remediation_hint: Name Jamie's supported action and the shared boundary in the same record.

evals.title: New-operator lifecycle commands
procedure: Run every command with --help.
Validate a public-safe intake candidate without auto-promoting it.
Query stable IDs, projects, statuses, sources, inquiries, projections, and held or research views.
Mutation-test private and credential leaks.
pass_criteria: Commands are read-only or append-safe.
Invalid input and broken graph state return nonzero.
No command creates a public claim automatically.
A new contributor can operate the workflow from help text.
evals.remediation_hint: Keep the CLI thin and wrap the canonical records instead of inventing storage.

evals.title: Survivorship, rights, and research re-entry
procedure: Audit recovered, partial, not-recovered, and indirect populations.
Separate factual support, quotation permission, artifact rights, image permission, participant consent, and display approval.
Verify discoveries re-enter through intake or inquiry.
pass_criteria: Negative search language remains bounded.
Protected source scans stay outside Git.
Rights and consent are not inferred from factual support.
Photo and collaborator leads cannot mature claims automatically.
evals.remediation_hint: Record what survived and what remains unknown without turning absence into a historical fact.

evals.title: Selective public composition and mosaic privacy
procedure: Verify every public route or route template has audience, argument, action, selected claims, claim budget, and omission rationale.
Check claim counts against budgets.
Review individually safe fragments in combination.
pass_criteria: The website remains a composed argument rather than a bank dump.
Every selected proof has role evidence.
Unselected mature knowledge remains explicitly held.
Mosaic review identifies combinations that must stay omitted or generalized.
evals.remediation_hint: Remove or defer the least useful claim before expanding a route's budget.

evals.title: Evaluator trust, calibration, and unchanged-candidate holdouts
procedure: Each judge verifies the frozen instrument, its own independence, and the exact candidate binding without inspecting the other receipt.
The deterministic aggregate checker verifies two distinct judges, exact receipt schemas, identical candidate SHA and fingerprints, and receipt-level CI-007 scores of at least 3.
Only that aggregate checker derives final CI-007 = 4.
Normalize all remaining scores to 0-4 and weighted 0-1.
pass_criteria: Rubric and candidate fingerprints are exact.
No optimizer self-grade is counted.
Each receipt independently scores evaluator trust at least 3 without claiming to prove the unseen receipt.
The aggregate checker proves both receipts bind one unchanged candidate before deriving 4.
Critical regressions cannot be averaged away.
evals.remediation_hint: Discard invalid receipts and rerun independent judges on the unchanged candidate.

evals.title: Layered verification and release policy
procedure: Run deterministic source and graph checks.
Inspect responsive routes, keyboard behavior, metadata, and console output.
Build and smoke the production runtime.
Run staging and production-mode policies separately.
pass_criteria: All machine layers pass.
Staging remains noindex.
Production indexing remains explicit and approval-gated.
Human release decisions remain reserved to humans.
evals.remediation_hint: Repair the failing layer and rerun all later layers on the same candidate.

evals.title: Truthful human and consent gates
procedure: Verify human-only statuses use pending, approved, rejected, or expired states.
Reject automated approval, null reviewer on approved records, and unbound production approval.
pass_criteria: PR-019 and PR-025 remain truthful.
Rights and collaborator consent holds remain visible.
No AI or protocol is represented as a human decision.
Production approval binds the exact candidate or remains pending.
evals.remediation_hint: Use stop_human_blocked when the next valid action belongs to a person.
